function kbStTick(dt){if(!KBST.on)return;KBST.t+=dt;KBST.cd=Math.max(0,KBST.cd-dt);if(KBST.blast)KBST.blast.t-=dt;
 const p=KBST.people[KBST.active];if(!KBST.dialog){
  const [dx,dy]=mv(),runK=(K.shift||hA||GPR)?1:0,sp=runK?350:260;
  p.x=KBSTLIMIT(p.x+dx*sp*dt,24,WW-24);p.y=KBSTLIMIT(p.y+dy*sp*dt,24,WH-24);
  // Instead of punishing wrong turns, gently resolve map collisions.
  push(p,11);
  const moving=Math.hypot(dx,dy)>.1;p.m+=(Number(moving)-p.m)*Math.min(1,dt*12);if(moving){p.w+=dt*sp/14;p.f=Math.atan2(dy,dx);p.dx=dx>0?1:dx<0?-1:p.dx;}p.run=runK;
  if(KBST.phase===0&&KBSTdist(p,KBST.people[1])<95){kbStAct0()}
  else if(KBST.phase===2&&KBST.active===1&&KBSTdist(p,KBST.people[2])<175){kbStGhostEncounter()}
  else if(KBST.phase===4&&KBSTdist(KBST.people[0],KBST.people[1])<105){kbStNews()}
  else if(KBST.phase===5&&KBSTdist(p,{x:846,y:2978})<116){kbStMemorial()}
  if(KBST.phase===3&&KBST.ghost){const g=KBST.ghost;g.y+=Math.sin(KBST.t*2)*.08;g.flash=Math.max(0,g.flash-dt*3);if(KBST.active===1&&KBSTdist(p,g)>365)kbStTagOnce('Priđi Peri — duh je blizu njegove kuće.');}
 }else p.m=0;
 if(KBST.phase===4||KBST.phase===5){const other=KBST.people[1-KBST.active];if(other)other.m=0}
 pl.x=p.x;pl.y=p.y;pl.f=p.f;pl.dx=p.dx;pl.m=p.m;pl.w=p.w;pl.run=p.run;
 cam.x+=(pl.x-cam.x)*Math.min(1,dt*9);cam.y+=(pl.y-cam.y)*Math.min(1,dt*9);
 if(Math.floor(KBST.t*6)%3===0)kbStHUD();
}

const NV={g:null,route:null,cum:null,tot:0,t:0,on:0,ins:'',dist:0,cx:-1,cy:-1};
function nvGraph(){const id=new Map(),N=[],adj=[];const gid=(x,y)=>{const k=Math.round(x/4)+','+Math.round(y/4);let i=id.get(k);if(i==null){i=N.length;id.set(k,i);N.push([x,y]);adj.push([])}return i};
const lines=[P,...BR];const pts=[];lines.forEach(q=>q.forEach(p=>pts.push(p)));
lines.forEach(q=>{for(let i=1;i<q.length;i++){const a=q[i-1],b=q[i],on=[];
/* T-raskrsnice: tačka druge ulice koja pada na ovaj segment */
pts.forEach(p=>{if(p===a||p===b)return;const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],t=((p[0]-a[0])*dx+(p[1]-a[1])*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(t>.01&&t<.99&&sg(p[0],p[1],a,b)<6)on.push([t,p])});
on.sort((u,v)=>u[0]-v[0]);const ch=[a,...on.map(o=>o[1]),b];
for(let j=1;j<ch.length;j++){const u=gid(...ch[j-1]),v=gid(...ch[j]);if(u==v)continue;const w=Math.hypot(N[u][0]-N[v][0],N[u][1]-N[v][1]);if(!adj[u].some(e=>e[0]==v)){adj[u].push([v,w]);adj[v].push([u,w])}}}});
NV.g={N,adj}}
/* najbliža tačka na putevima (snap) */
function nvSnap(x,y){let best=1e9,bp=null,ba=null,bb=null;[P,...BR].forEach(q=>{for(let i=1;i<q.length;i++){const a=q[i-1],b=q[i],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a[0])*dx+(y-a[1])*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy))),px=a[0]+t*dx,py=a[1]+t*dy,d=Math.hypot(x-px,y-py);if(d<best){best=d;bp=[px,py];ba=a;bb=b}}});return{p:bp,a:ba,b:bb}}
function nvRoute(){if(!NV.g)nvGraph();const{N,adj}=NV.g;
const find=p=>{let bi=-1,bd=1e9;N.forEach((n,i)=>{const d=Math.hypot(n[0]-p[0],n[1]-p[1]);if(d<bd){bd=d;bi=i}});return bi};
const s=nvSnap(pl.x,pl.y),e=nvSnap(lz.x,lz.y);
/* privremeni čvorovi: početak (na putu) i kraj (na putu) */
const ia=N.length,ib=ia+1,ad=adj.map(a=>a.slice()),NN=N.slice();NN.push(s.p,e.p);ad.push([],[]);
const link=(i,j)=>{const w=Math.hypot(NN[i][0]-NN[j][0],NN[i][1]-NN[j][1]);ad[i].push([j,w]);ad[j].push([i,w])};
/* poveži privremeni čvor sa krajevima segmenta na kome stoji (segment je podeljen na raskrsnicama -> traži susede preko graf-čvorova na toj duži) */
const att=(ti,sn)=>{const on=[];N.forEach((n,i)=>{if(sg(n[0],n[1],sn.a,sn.b)<6)on.push(i)});
on.sort((u,v)=>Math.hypot(N[u][0]-sn.a[0],N[u][1]-sn.a[1])-Math.hypot(N[v][0]-sn.a[0],N[v][1]-sn.a[1]));
const pd=Math.hypot(sn.p[0]-sn.a[0],sn.p[1]-sn.a[1]);let lo=-1,hi=-1;on.forEach(i=>{const d=Math.hypot(N[i][0]-sn.a[0],N[i][1]-sn.a[1]);if(d<=pd+.5)lo=i;else if(hi<0)hi=i});if(lo>=0)link(ti,lo);if(hi>=0)link(ti,hi);if(lo<0&&hi<0)link(ti,find(sn.p))};
att(ia,s);att(ib,e);
/* ako su na istom segmentu — direktna veza */
if(s.a===e.a&&s.b===e.b)link(ia,ib);
/* Dijkstra */
const dist2=new Array(NN.length).fill(1e12),prev=new Array(NN.length).fill(-1),done=new Array(NN.length).fill(0);dist2[ia]=0;
for(;;){let u=-1,m=1e12;for(let i=0;i<NN.length;i++)if(!done[i]&&dist2[i]<m){m=dist2[i];u=i}if(u<0||u==ib)break;done[u]=1;ad[u].forEach(([v,w])=>{if(dist2[u]+w<dist2[v]){dist2[v]=dist2[u]+w;prev[v]=u}})}
if(prev[ib]<0&&ia!=ib){NV.route=null;return}
const path=[],pdg=[];for(let u=ib;u>=0;u=prev[u]){path.push(NN[u]);pdg.push(u<ia?adj[u].length:0)}path.reverse();pdg.reverse();
/* dodaj početak (igrač) i kraj (Lazar) van puta */
const r=[[pl.x,pl.y],...path,[lz.x,lz.y]];const cum=[0];for(let i=1;i<r.length;i++)cum.push(cum[i-1]+Math.hypot(r[i][0]-r[i-1][0],r[i][1]-r[i-1][1]));
NV.route=r;NV.cum=cum;NV.tot=cum[cum.length-1];NV.jn=nvTurns(r,cum,[0,...pdg,0])}
/* uputstva: skretanja veća od ~28° */
function nvTurns(r,cum,dg){const T=[];for(let i=1;i<r.length-1;i++){if(dg[i]<3||cum[i]<20)continue;const a=Math.atan2(r[i][1]-r[i-1][1],r[i][0]-r[i-1][0]),b=Math.atan2(r[i+1][1]-r[i][1],r[i+1][0]-r[i][0]);let d=b-a;while(d>Math.PI)d-=6.2832;while(d<-Math.PI)d+=6.2832;const deg=d*57.2958,ad=Math.abs(deg);
T.push({i,at:cum[i],x:r[i][0],y:r[i][1],deg,txt:ad<=28?'Nastavi RAVNO':ad>135?'Okreni se nazad':deg>0?(ad>70?'Skreni DESNO':'Drži se DESNO'):(ad>70?'Skreni LEVO':'Drži se LEVO'),sym:ad<=28?'↑':deg>0?'→':'←'})}return T}
/* pozicija igrača duž rute */
function nvAlong(){const r=NV.route;let best=1e9,al=0;for(let i=1;i<r.length;i++){const a=r[i-1],b=r[i],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],L2=dx*dx+dy*dy||1,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((pl.x-a[0])*dx+(pl.y-a[1])*dy)/L2)),px=a[0]+t*dx,py=a[1]+t*dy,d=Math.hypot(pl.x-px,pl.y-py);if(d<best){best=d;al=NV.cum[i-1]+t*Math.sqrt(L2)}}return{al,off:best}}
function nvPt(s){const r=NV.route,c2=NV.cum;s=Math.max(0,Math.min(NV.tot,s));for(let i=1;i<r.length;i++)if(c2[i]>=s){const t=(s-c2[i-1])/((c2[i]-c2[i-1])||1);return[r[i-1][0]+(r[i][0]-r[i-1][0])*t,r[i-1][1]+(r[i][1]-r[i-1][1])*t,Math.atan2(r[i][1]-r[i-1][1],r[i][0]-r[i-1][0])]}const l=r[r.length-1];return[l[0],l[1],0]}
function nvActive(){return mode==1&&!window.KB_FREE&&!lz.on&&!lz.dead&&!ride&&!dead&&!cr&&dist(lz,pl)>300}
/* ažuriranje: ruta se preračuna kad se igrač pomeri (~60 px) */
function nvUp(dt){NV.t+=dt;const a=nvActive();NV.on=a;if(!a){NV.route=null;return}
